title: A Codex multi-agent v1 spawn made from a script does not link its child
foundBy: session agent, 2026-11-13, from a Codex 0.166 multi-agent v1 capture the host asked for: "can we run this with the creds we have right now?"
details: Codex picks multi-agent v1 or v2 per model, from its model catalog. On a v1 model such as gpt-5.6-luna, the model calls the collaboration tools from inside its `exec` tool, a JavaScript script that calls `tools.multi_agent_v1__spawn_agent`. The rollout records that `exec` call, then a `CollabAgentToolCall` notice whose `receiver_thread_ids` name the child, then the script's output. The notice's id is `exec-<uuid>` and matches no call, so the adapter tallies it and links nothing. The child still names its parent from its own `session_meta`, but the parent's call that spawned it carries no `childSessionId`, and the tree stamps no `parentEventIndex` on the child. The v1 rule from TRC-059 was written from the source, which shows a direct `spawn_agent` call, and no v1 capture existed to test it.
